normal_mesh.method: Map each source triangle corner to an actual 3MF vertex. Require exact oriented-face multiset equality after recording the collapsed source faces. Verify final edge/vertex manifold, winding and connectivity. Corresponding triangle points move no more than the maximum corner displacement by barycentric interpolation. This explains numerical conversion, not byte or face-count identity.

method: Actual G-code positive extrusion with .00125 mm maximum arc sagitta, width/2+.002 mm circumscribed footprint and full layer slab; explicit 3MF affine maps. Feature box intersections are conservative. Core checks are finite declared pick paths, not entire-hole dimensional acceptance. Exact X54 face disambiguates only that specific datum.
limits: No physical support separation/grip/debris or dimensional/strength proof.
Bridge path length is not unsupported span.
Open channels require clipping tree branches before gibs, nuts, keeper, hose or host installation.
Textured PEI and Generic PETG remain analysis assumptions.
